name: chat-message
title: Chat Message
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Message bubble for a person or an assistant, with avatar, time, sending and error states, and copy, retry, and regenerate actions.

meta.descriptionEs: Burbuja de mensaje para la persona o el asistente, con avatar, hora, estados de envío y error, y acciones de copiar, reintentar y regenerar.

examples.title: Mensaje de chat
examples.description: Burbuja de mensaje para la persona o el asistente, con avatar, hora, estados de envío y error, y acciones de copiar, reintentar y regenerar.

api.name: role
api.description: Which side and tone to use.

api.name: onRetry / onRegenerate / onCopy
api.description: Optional actions. Copy uses copyText or the text content.

api.name: labels
api.description: sendingLabel, errorLabel, retryLabel, copyLabel, copiedLabel, and regenerateLabel default to English.

api.name: variant
api.description: note tints the bubble with the host accent and shows noteLabel. Existing roles are unchanged.

api.name: receipt
api.description: Optional seen state under the bubble. seenLabel and unseenLabel default to English.

api.name: side
api.description: Overrides the side implied by role. Omit it to keep the previous placement.

api.name: reactions / onReact
api.description: Optional reaction chips. Adapted from Arc UI (MIT).

docs: Import ChatMessage from the installed UI file. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Adapted behaviors from Arc UI (MIT) are optional and do not change existing props. The internal-note variant and the seen state are original and optional.
